theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Mutual Fund Expense Ratios Explained
body: Expense ratios are annual costs of managing your investments. They impact long-term returns and vary across fund types.
caption: Every fund charges fees to cover operational costs. Lower ratios can mean more money stays invested over time. Know what you're paying before investing. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestmentCosts #SmartInvesting #KnowYourFunds
